cards.title: Lowest-revenue products
cards.sql:
SELECT i.product, SUM(i.net_amount_czk) AS revenue_czk,
       COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
FROM invoices i
WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY i.product
ORDER BY revenue_czk ASC
LIMIT 3

cards.title: companies overdue
cards.sql:
SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'Total' AS company_name, COUNT(i.invoice_id) AS overdue_invoices_count
FROM invoices i
WHERE i.payment_status = 'Overdue'
UNION ALL
SELECT c.company_name, COUNT(i.invoice_id) AS overdue_invoices_count
FROM companies c
LEFT JOIN invoices i ON c.company_id = i.company_id AND i.payment_status = 'Overdue'
GROUP BY c.company_name
ORDER BY company_name = 'Total' DESC, company_name
LIMIT 500) AS _bounded_result LIMIT 500

cards.title: creata a histogram with segments and their reveue
cards.sql:
SELECT * FROM (SELECT segment, SUM(net_amount_czk) AS total_revenue_czk
FROM companies c
JOIN invoices i ON c.company_id = i.company_id
WHERE i.payment_status = 'Paid'
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY total_revenue_czk DESC
LIMIT 500) AS _bounded_result LIMIT 500
